case.summary: Transaction 3514030 for $77.07 in region 444 was flagged by a legacy risk score of 0.61, though the bank's calibrated fraud model scored it low at 0.071. Investigation showed the transaction matched the holder's established weekly recurring purchase cadence of approximately $77 in region 444, where the holder has 10 prior legitimate in-person transactions and no link to confirmed fraud. Regional analysis showed no abnormal fraud lift, and prior closed cases on the card belonged to other unrelated holder identities within the shared issuer bucket. Customer validation confirmed the charge as a legitimate recurring payment, and the alert was ruled a false alarm.
